name: dev-kit
description: PeoplesHR developer build tooling. Ships the hrm-deployment-script skill for reformatting SQL to PHR conventions in .NET Framework projects, the hrm-notification skill for building a Job Scheduler email notification for any module, the phx-debugger skill for fixing an Azure DevOps bug end to end from its bug ID, and the hrm-configuration-document skill for writing the house Configuration Document (.md, .docx, PDF) for a finished CR. Declares no MCP servers of its own.
